footer.default: These benefits come from keeping jaggery closer to its original form, less processed, more complete.

default.title: Rich in Iron — Prevents Anaemia
default.body: Jaggery is an excellent source of plant-based iron. Some studies suggest that the iron found in jaggery is more easily absorbed by the body than other types of plant-based iron.

default.title: Rich in Vital Minerals
default.body: Naturally rich in calcium, potassium and phosphorus — minerals that support bone strength, steady energy, and overall wellness.

default.title: Boosts Immunity
default.body: Jaggery helps strengthen the body’s natural defenses and combat oxidative stress.

default.title: Respiratory Health
default.body: Traditionally used to ease coughs, colds and congestion. Its warming nature helps clear airways and soothe the throat.

default.title: Aids Digestion
default.body: Acts as a natural digestive — stimulates digestive enzymes and supports a healthy gut, which is why it’s often eaten after meals.
